0022600179.text: The Utah Jazz (1-6, 0-2 on the road, five straight losses) visit the New Orleans Pelicans (3-4) for Utah's eighth game of the 2026-27 season, and the Jazz sit 14th in the West. Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), while New Orleans is without Dejounte Murray (personal), Jordan Poole (ankle sprain) and Yves Missi (knee bruise), and the Pelicans come in on a three-game winning streak. The Jazz lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 120-119 win in Salt Lake City on October 23, and they lost all three meetings with New Orleans in 2025-26.
